plannedDuration.description:
The expected amount of time, in hours, required to complete an activity.
The planned working time is calculated using the activity's calendar. The duration is measured from the activity planned start date to the activity planned finish date.

remainingDuration.description: The total working time, in hours, from the activity remaining start date to the activity remaining finish date.

durationType.description: Determines how remaining duration, units, and units/time are calculated when you update an activity that has resources assigned. The valid values are Fixed Units/Time, Fixed Units, Fixed Duration & Units, and Fixed Duration & Units/Time.

projectId.description: The unique identifier for the project.

planStartDate.description:
The start date for the time phased Planned Budget of the project.
Planned Budget cost spread will adjust when this date is changed.
The Project Planned Start also represents the earliest date that activities can occur within a project schedule.

dataDate.description:
The progress point, or "as-of date", for activities in the project. Project status is up-to-date as of the data date. You can set the data date when you schedule the project, or you can set it manually.
The data date is also used for updating the dates of scope assignments and work packages when they are not linked to activities.

projectCode.description: The unique identifier for a project set by the user who created the project.
